changelog: Alpha Party Window v1.32: Fixed buried chat messages with 24px bottom spacer, moved animation strip to top header, added 3-way Mention options (Profile, Account, Nickname), and upgraded header cycle button to 3 modes.
added: 3-way Mention popup: choose to mention by Profile Name, Account Tag, or Custom Nickname
Header player names 3-way cycle button (🔄): switch between Profile Names, Account Names, and Nicknames
24px bottom chat spacer anchor: ensures latest chat messages are never buried under UI elements or cut off
Top header animation strip: visualizer moved to top of chat panel so bottom chat messages are 100% unobstructed
External floating side dock: keeps navigation, copy, reply and translation safe from mobile misclicks
Pure static mode: cleanly hides animation bars and borders when animations are set to Off
changed: Stretched bottom input text bar and enlarged Send button for mobile touch comfort
Clean non-emoji Kick Vote / Kick Player popup options
Zero left-margin text alignment across chat rows and input field
Removed pulse wave animation mode for smoother visualizer rendering
